name: Atlantis-Pak
verdict: Part of Agrokom Group, owned by Rostov businessman Ivan Savvidi. Nothing found.
note: FC Rostov's title sponsor; wordmark across the chest of the 2026-27 home shirt. Rating note: private Russian food-packaging group (world's largest producer of plastic sausage casings per the club's sponsor profile); chain ends at private owner Ivan Savvidi, no state stake found, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company (searched 3 Oct 2026). Ukraine's 2024 confiscation of Savvidi-related shares is a sanctions action, which does not count under METHOD.md.
